admission.justification: The explicit-write checker and dependency snapshot adapter are separate owners whose contract prevents a read from erasing historical removed-task IDs while a later field write silently keeps invalid prerequisites.

applicability: Existing waitsFor references to removed tasks, and the next explicit authoring of that field; retained abandoned tasks are distinct.
conditions: Existing references are not rewritten during a read; synthetic missing tasks display as gone.
The next explicit field write removes IDs no longer admitted by the master current task index.
Abandonment alone is not synthetic gone.
exclusions: Silently rewriting the historical reference during a read or an unrelated edit.
Treating an unresolved reference as completed.
statement: Removed prerequisites remain in existing waitsFor data and display as gone; the next explicit write of that field drops IDs no longer admitted by the master task index. A known abandoned task instead retains its native aborted state, not a fabricated gone marker.
